title: Person Centered Direct Support January 19, 2027
summary: Course utilizes the skills to integrate direct care support.
description: Person Centered Planning aka 'The Setting Rule', became law in March 2023. This training will discuss the Ruling, touch on disability history and discuss skills to integrate Person Centered Planning into every day Direct Care support. Learners will practice person centered skills such as; informed decision making and having difficult conversations. This 3 hour training will include Polls, Breakout rooms and group discussion. This training is part of the accredited DSP Training Certification Program with AKTC.
